{{Vanilla|Redstone Comparator}}
{{Infobox auto}}
An '''electric comparator''' is a circuit component that compares, subtracts and measures signals. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Redstone Comparator|redstone comparator}} under a new name, and it works the same way.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe is the vanilla one, with the renamed ingredients: three [[Electric Inverter|electric inverters]] around a piece of [[quartz]], above three [[limestone]].

=== Trading ===
The [[Engineer]] sells 64 electric comparators for 1 [[obol]] at the novice level.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/armorer/1/comparator.json}}</ref>
